findings.detail: Main action1 enters0x42b0ce connected-computer screen. Successful confirm calls common0x42a3f6; player selection0x410f81 then invokes arena/wins0x406dde before battle. Original connected-client list has4entries.
Main action2 enters0x42b47d discovery. Selecting a nonempty node attempts connection, waits for host, then enters common setup0x42a3f6. Joiners do not choose an independent scheme.

Options0x4080dc case8 invokes0x407582. Its assembly loads filter address0x458b0b, whose bytes are2a2e53434800 (*.SCH), uses message721 Available Scheme Files and updates current filename0x4648c4 only after a non-cancelled selection. Scheme is one optional Options choice.
0x406dde has two selectable rows (arena and victory target), no scheme step. Host sends choices; client follows them read-only. The illustrative5x5 sample is independent of scheme.

0x421e80 cycles OFF0->AI1->KEY2(index0/1)->JOY3->OFF; it skips AI for network clients.0x410f81 protects NET4 from ordinary Left/Right. Host o/O/0 bypasses that guard, updates player mode0, and retains the connected node.

Left can turn an owned KEY/JOY row OFF without a last-host-human guard.0x422085 rejects duplicate KEY/JOY bindings;0x42223e counts active players/distinct teams and caller requires2. A host-human lock would be an invented restriction.

Personal color follows the selected Player1..10 row. Rows use white,black,red,blue,green,yellow,cyan,magenta,orange,purple. T changes team when Team Play is enabled; AI/team assignment is host-controlled. No separate personal-color wizard is documented.

implementation_model.transport_screen: LAN discovery or Internet server connection, nickname and controls preferences; host/join choice.
implementation_model.host: One players/nodes page, optional Options, then arena/wins, then battle. No forced separate controls confirmation.
implementation_model.join: Choose discovered game, select own KEY/JOY row if changing saved controls/color, follow host.
implementation_model.capacity: One host plus9clients,10active player rows. This extends the original4-client computer limit.
implementation_model.scheme: One optional Scheme File entry under Options; received host scheme remains session state on clients.

limitations: Original Windows executable was not executed; native behavior is derived from Ghidra decompilation/assembly and corroborated with imported original help/video/user screenshots.
Watcom register calling conventions make some decompiled function parameters unreliable; assembly and literal bytes were used for the Scheme File dispatch/filter.
Modern transport configuration and nine-client limit are explicit additions.
